name: Meta
tagline: Create a Meta app for Facebook Pages (and Instagram), pass App Review, and plug it into Composio.

approvalWait.asStated: App Review: "you should receive a decision within a week". Meta's developer docs give no Business Verification timeline.

cost.asStated: No fee for the app, App Review, or Business Verification in any Meta doc we read.

steps.title: Set up your Composio account
steps.when: Skip if you already have a Composio project and API key.
instructions: Sign up from the Composio login page.
Open Settings → API keys and copy a key.
Save it as COMPOSIO_API_KEY where your agent runs.
Stay in this project. Auth configs belong to one project.

problems.q: I can't find the API keys page
a: Open the API keys link above after signing in. It opens Settings → API keys for your current project.
If you have several projects, switch to the one you'll use for this agent first.

steps.title: Create the Meta app
instructions: Register as a Meta developer if you haven't, then open the app creation page.
App details: enter the app name and a contact email. Click Next.
Use cases: select Manage everything on your Page. Click Next.
Business: pick your business portfolio, or Create a business portfolio.
Click Next through Requirements, then Go to dashboard on Overview.

fields.label: Use case
fields.hint: Covers Pages via Facebook Login for Business

fields.label: Business portfolio
fields.hint: Needed to access Pages you don't own. Can be added later.

warnings.text: Use cases can't be removed once added. Incompatible use cases are greyed out.
Don't add Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login. It's incompatible with the Pages use case.

steps.unconfirmed: Logged out, the app creation page returns Page Not Found, so we couldn't walk the signed-in flow ourselves.

problems.q: Meta won't let me create another app
a: You can hold a developer or admin role on at most 15 apps not tied to a verified business.
Connect a verified business portfolio, delete unused apps (archived ones count), or leave old apps.

steps.title: Pick the Page permissions
instructions: In Dashboard, open Customize the Manage everything on your Page use case.
business_management, pages_show_list and public_profile are required and can't be removed.
Click Add next to each extra permission your Composio tools need. Skip the rest.
pages_manage_engagement is added by default. Remove it if you won't moderate comments.

fields.label: Common additions
fields.hint: Read posts/comments and publish as the Page. Trim to your tools.

warnings.text: Every permission needs its own review. Unneeded permissions are a common reason for rejection.

steps.title: Add Composio's redirect URI
instructions: In the left menu, open Facebook Login for Business → Settings.
Paste the URI below as a Redirect URI and click Check URI.
Under Client OAuth settings, keep Client OAuth login and Web OAuth login on.
Click Save changes.
Strict mode needs an exact match: no trailing slash, no extra query string.

fields.label: Valid OAuth Redirect URI
fields.hint: Must match your Composio auth config exactly

warnings.text: App settings → Advanced has a Share Redirect allow list. That's for link shares, not OAuth. Use Facebook Login for Business → Settings.

problems.q: "URL Blocked: This redirect failed because the redirect URI is not whitelisted"
a: The login dialog got a redirect URI that isn't in your Valid OAuth Redirect URIs list.
Paste Composio's URI exactly, keep Client and Web OAuth login on, and save.

problems.q: "Can't load URL: The domain of this URL isn't included in the app's domains"
a: Meta returns this (error 191) when the redirect URI isn't registered on the app. We reproduced it live.
Add the URI in Facebook Login for Business → Settings. If it persists, add backend.composio.dev to App settings → Basic → App Domains.

steps.title: Copy the App ID and App Secret
instructions: Open App settings → Basic.
Copy the App ID. Composio calls it Client ID.
Reveal the App Secret (Meta asks for your password) and copy it. Composio calls it Client Secret.
Store the secret in a secret manager, never in git or client code.

warnings.text: If Meta finds your secret leaked and you don't reset it, Meta resets it and revokes user grants.

a: The App Secret in Composio doesn't match the app. Copy it again from App settings → Basic.
If you reset the secret in Meta, update your Composio auth config too.

problems.q: Meta says "Missing or invalid client id"
a: Composio sent an App ID Meta doesn't know. Copy the App ID from the dashboard toolbar or Basic settings.
Don't paste the Instagram App ID here. It belongs to the instagram toolkit.

steps.unconfirmed: We couldn't see the signed-in Basic page. The reveal button and password prompt are from past dashboards.

steps.title: Fill in the settings Meta needs to go live
instructions: Open App settings → Basic and fill in every field below.
Upload an app icon: JPEG, GIF or PNG, 512–1024 px square, under 5 MB, no Meta logos.
Set App Purpose to Clients if people without a role on your app will connect.
Add Data Protection Officer contact details if you do business in the EU.
Click Save changes.

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.hint: App Review results and alerts go here

fields.label: Privacy Policy URL
fields.hint: Shown to users on the login dialog

fields.label: User Data Deletion
fields.hint: Instructions URL or a deletion callback

warnings.text: Changing Basic or Advanced settings after you submit for review may trigger a re-review.

steps.title: Create a Composio auth config
instructions: Open the Facebook toolkit in Composio and create an auth config.
Choose OAuth2 and turn on your own developer credentials.
Paste the App ID as Client ID and the App Secret as Client Secret.
Set scopes to exactly the permissions you added in the use case.
Save, then copy the auth config ID (ac_…) for the next step.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.hint: Must match Facebook Login for Business → Settings exactly

fields.label: Starter scopes
fields.hint: Trim to your use case's permissions

warnings.text: Scopes not approved in App Review only work for people with a role on your app.

steps.unconfirmed: The link exists. We couldn't check, without logging in, whether it opens auth config creation directly. If not: Auth Configs → Create Auth Config.

problems.q: The link didn't open the Facebook toolkit
a: Open Auth Configs in the Composio dashboard and click Create Auth Config.
Pick Facebook, choose OAuth2, and turn on your own developer credentials.

steps.title: Use the auth config in your agent
instructions: Pass the auth config ID when you create a session. Your coding agent can paste this in.
Toolkits you don't list keep using Composio's managed auth.

a: The session must include authConfigs with your ac_… ID for facebook.
Toolkits not listed in authConfigs fall back to managed auth.

steps.title: Test with people who have an app role
instructions: Until review, only people with a role on the app can grant permissions (Standard Access).
Add teammates under App roles → Roles as Developers or Testers.
If the app has a business portfolio, manage roles in Business Manager instead.
Connect a Page you admin through Composio. The login should show your app's name.
Call each permission you'll request at least once (Graph API v26.0). Review needs a logged call from the last 30 days.

warnings.text: Testers must be your employees or contracted to test for you. Most apps can have up to 50.
The facebook toolkit works with Pages only, not personal profiles.

steps.unconfirmed: We didn't run a full connection. It needs a Composio API key and a signed-in Facebook account with an app role.

problems.q: The consent screen still says Composio
a: The connection used the managed auth config. Pass your ac_… ID in the session.
Existing connections keep their old config. Delete and reconnect them.

problems.q: Facebook shows an invalid App ID error page
a: The App ID in Composio is malformed. Copy it again from App settings → Basic.
Logged out, Facebook only checks well-formed IDs after sign-in, so test while signed in.

problems.q: My list of Pages comes back empty
a: The person must be able to perform a task on the Page, and grant pages_show_list.
Reconnect and select the Page in the Facebook dialog.

steps.title: Set up Instagram business login
steps.when: Only if you'll also use the instagram toolkit with your own Meta app.
instructions: Composio's instagram toolkit uses Instagram Login (graph.instagram.com), not Facebook Login.
Create an app with use case Other, app type Business, then add the Instagram product.
Go to Instagram → API setup with Instagram login → 3. Set up Instagram business login.
Open Business login settings and add the URI below under OAuth Redirect URIs. Save.
Copy the Instagram App ID and Instagram App Secret shown there, not the Meta App ID.
Create an instagram auth config in Composio and add it to authConfigs.
Request the instagram_business_* permissions in the same review steps below.

warnings.text: The dashboard may add a trailing slash to your URI. Check the saved list matches exactly.
Only Instagram Business or Creator accounts can connect. Personal accounts are rejected.

steps.unconfirmed: We didn't confirm whether the Instagram product can be added to the Pages use-case app, so we use a second app.

a: The client ID isn't an Instagram App ID. We reproduced this with an unknown ID.
Use the Instagram App ID from Business login settings, not the Meta App ID.

steps.title: Become a Tech Provider and verify your business
instructions: In the dashboard, click Become a Tech Provider → Yes, I'm a Tech Provider.
Click Business verification, or open App settings → Basic → Verification → Start Verification.
Connect your business portfolio. If it's already verified, you're done.
Otherwise click Start Business Verification. It opens Business Manager.
Submit your legal business details and documents there.
Only an Admin of the business portfolio can complete verification.

warnings.text: Without a verified business, users outside your app's roles can't grant Advanced Access permissions.

steps.unconfirmed: Meta's list of accepted documents is in a Business Help Center page we couldn't load.

problems.q: Business Verification is stuck or I can't start it
a: Only a business portfolio Admin can complete it. Ask one to finish it in Business Manager.
For document or status questions, use Meta Business support below.

steps.title: Wait for Business Verification
instructions: Status shows Pending, then Verified, under App settings → Basic → Verification.
Keep building and testing with role users meanwhile.

wait.asStated: Meta's developer docs give no timeline. Status moves from Pending to Verified.

steps.unconfirmed: Search snippets cite "up to 14 business days" from Meta's Business Help Center; we couldn't load that page to confirm.

steps.title: Draft the review text and screencast script
instructions: For each permission, draft a usage description: how it helps users and how you use the data.
Write a separate description per permission. Meta rejects copy-paste.
Script one screencast per permission: Facebook login granting it, then the feature using it.
Follow each permission's Screencast Requirements in Meta's permissions reference.
Write reviewer instructions to reach your product, with test login for your product only.

warnings.text: Never give reviewers your personal Facebook credentials. Meta tests with its own accounts.

steps.title: Record screencasts and submit App Review
instructions: Record in English UI at 1080p or better. Show the cursor. Audio isn't reviewed.
Go to Review → App Review and click Edit to start your submission.
Complete App Settings, then Provide reviewer instructions for each platform.
Answer the data handling questions if prompted.
Open each permission: paste its description, upload its screencast, tick allowed usage.
Click Submit for Review and accept the Platform Onboarding Terms.

warnings.text: Request advanced access stays grey until a successful call with that permission is logged (up to 2 days).
If reviewers can't reach your app, the whole submission is rejected.

problems.q: App Review rejected one or more permissions
a: Read the reason in the dashboard Alerts or your contact email.
Usually the screencast didn't show the permission in use, or the description was generic.
Fix that permission's description or screencast, then resubmit.

problems.q: The Request advanced access button is greyed out
a: Make one successful API call with that permission, from your app or Graph API Explorer.
Wait up to 2 days for it to be logged. It must be within 30 days of submitting.

steps.title: Wait for App Review
instructions: Meta queues your submission and tests your app with its own accounts.
The decision arrives by email and in the dashboard Alerts.

wait.asStated: "You should receive a decision within a week." Not a guarantee; resubmissions restart the clock.

steps.unconfirmed: "Resubmissions restart the clock" is our reading. Meta doesn't state resubmission timing.

steps.title: Publish the app
instructions: Only publish after App Review approves every permission you need.
Select Publish in the left menu, review your use cases and requirements, then click Publish.
Reconnect your test Page through Composio with an account that has no app role.

warnings.text: Test posts made in Development mode become visible to everyone once you publish.
Facebook Login for Business apps need Advanced Access to public_profile before going live.
User tokens last about 60 days at most, and data access expires after 90 days of inactivity. Users must then reconnect.

problems.q: "Feature Unavailable: Facebook Login is currently unavailable for this app"
a: Usually a permission the login asks for lacks Advanced Access. Facebook Login for Business needs it for public_profile.
Check App Review → Permissions and Features and request or restore Advanced Access.
If it persists, ask Meta Developer Support or file a bug report.

problems.q: Users without an app role can't connect after publishing
a: They can only grant permissions approved for Advanced Access, from a verified business.
Remove unapproved scopes from your Composio auth config, or get them approved.

steps.title: Get Page access for your user
steps.when: Only if the person connecting can't perform tasks on the Page they want to use.
instructions: Your user can only grant Pages they own or can perform a task on.
A Page or business portfolio admin gives them a task, such as Create content or Moderate.
Your user then reconnects and selects that Page.
steps.unconfirmed: We didn't verify the current Meta Business Suite menu path for assigning Page tasks.

steps.title: Complete the annual Data Use Checkup
steps.when: Once a year after going live. Meta sends the deadline by email and Alerts.
instructions: An app admin opens the checkup from the dashboard banner or Alerts.
Review your approved permissions, features and products.
Certify allowed usage and policy compliance, and answer the data handling questions.
Add testing instructions for your app, then submit.

warnings.text: Miss the deadline and Meta deactivates the app until you finish. No extensions.

problems.q: Meta asked me to change my data handling answers
a: You have 20 calendar days to resubmit. The app stays live meanwhile.
After every third submission you must wait three days before resubmitting.

contacts.label: Meta Developer Support
contacts.when: App Review, data handling, or Data Use Checkup questions. Use Get Help → Ask a question. Replies within 2 business days.

contacts.label: Meta bug reporting tool
contacts.when: Login or API behaviour that contradicts Meta's docs even with correct settings.

contacts.label: Meta Business support
contacts.when: Business Verification, business portfolio, or payment issues. Needs a Business login.

contacts.label: Meta Developer Community Forum
contacts.when: Ask other developers about dashboard changes, review rejections, or odd login errors.

contacts.label: Composio Discord
contacts.when: Auth config, connection, or tool errors inside Composio.
